scope: The 2021 reconciliation package (Build Back Better), not H.R. 1
quote: We will only vote for a reconciliation package on the house floor that reinstates SALT.

scope: Stated generally: any changes to the tax code affecting families
quote: But if there are changes to the tax code that impact our families without reinstating SALT, my view is simple: No SALT? No Dice.

scope: Full SALT restoration for the 2025 tax year
quote: It is a down payment on our way to fully restoring the full deduction in 2025.

scope: Said about the House budget blueprint that led to H.R. 1
quote: I will fight tooth and nail to protect the programs that Jersey families depend on.

scope: Said about the House-passed version of H.R. 1
quote: We need to defend our Jersey Values, lower costs, and cut taxes, not create more chaos and abandon vulnerable seniors and hungry children.
On all fronts, I’ll keep fighting every day in Congress for lower taxes for our families and small businesses, and to make life more affordable for Jersey.

scope: Said about the House-passed version of H.R. 1
quote: the bill defunds key investments in alternative energy, including solar projects that we need to grow our energy supply in Jersey
You sent me to Congress to fight for lower taxes and Jersey Values.
